summary: Submitted an `explore` operation (harness: probe_config_publish_test.go) against the hashicorp/raft snapshot at c0dc6a0. Sourced suspicion: appendConfigurationEntry (raft.go:1203-1241) runs dispatchLogs first and then unconditionally publishes the new membership via setLatestConfiguration + commitment.setConfiguration + startStopReplication, even when dispatchLogs failed to persist the entry (dispatchLogs assigns applyLog.log.Index before StoreLogs, so future.Index() is still nonzero). The live configuration is the authority input for quorumSize/checkLeaderLease, requestVote/requestPreVote admission, and the runFollower election gate, so an unpersisted configuration can change the node's own quorum requirement. Local clean-copy execution (in-package Go test, in-memory transport/store, all timing driven by real config, no state injection) supplied one transient failure of the real LogStore.StoreLogs boundary on a just-committed single-voter cluster. Observed: AddVoter returned the store error; the assigned log slot was never durable (log not found, durable last index 3, raft last index 3); yet the node's published configuration now listed a phantom second voter; and the node never regained leadership (141 samples / 1.5s, state Candidate, voters=2, quorum=2, reachable voters=1), i.e. progress stops until a restart. A second observation from the same run: Raft.GetConfiguration().Index() returns 0 (api.go:897-906 leaves latestIndex unset in configurationsFuture, future.go:267-270), so the published index of the live authority context is not observable and cannot serve as the prevIndex guard accepted by AddVoter/RemoveServer. Evidence is conditional (the storage failure is injected, not produced by real producers); the submission records that boundary plus the unresolved discriminators (non-failure reachability, restart-only recovery, exact failure timings). Preflight validation passed (valid: true). No source, evidence, or dependency files were modified; work is limited to draft/probe_config_publish_test.go and draft/submission.json.
